item.title: Fake job interview opened the door to $6.34 billion Binance heist

item.title: Poisoned cPGuard update hits thousands of web hosting servers
item.description: An attacker has compromised the update infrastructure of cPGuard, a security suite for Linux web hosting servers, and pushed out a malicious update to nearly 3,000 customer servers. OPSShield, the company behind the security suite, also confirmed that the attacker made off with customer contact information and hashed passwords from the firm’s billing and licensing server. item.title: Malicious cPGuard Updates Served in OpsShield Supply Chain Attack
item.description: Using compromised credentials, the attackers accessed OpsShield’s update servers and poisoned multiple cPGuard versions. The post Malicious cPGuard Updates Served in OpsShield Supply Chain Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
